component.name: LivePlayer
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.overlay = m.top.findNode("overlay") m.channelName = m.top.findNode("channelName") m.videoTitle = m.top.findNode("videoTitle") m.errorLabel = m.top.findNode("errorLabel") m.hideTimer = m.top.findNode("hideOverlay") m.loadingBg = m.top.findNode("loadingBg") m.loadingText = m.top.findNode("loadingText") m.loadingSub = m.top.findNode("loadingSub")
m.hideTimer.observeField("fire", "onHideOverlay") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") end sub
sub onChannelSet() ch = m.top.channel m.channelName.text = ch.name showLoading(true, "Tuning in to " + ch.name + "...", "Please wait while we resolve the stream") showAndScheduleHide() playCurrentSlot() end sub
sub playCurrentSlot() ch = m.top.channel nowUtc = getUtcSeconds() slot = getCurrentVideo(ch, nowUtc) if slot = invalid showLoading(true, "No video scheduled right now", "Press BACK to return") return end if
m.currentSlot = slot m.videoTitle.text = slot.video.title
if slot.video.video_url <> invalid and Len(slot.video.video_url) > 0 showLoading(true, "Loading " + slot.video.title, "Buffering video...") startPlayback(slot.video.video_url, slot.seek) return end if
if slot.video.youtube_id <> invalid and Len(slot.video.youtube_id) > 0 showLoading(true, "Tuning in to " + ch.name + "...", "Resolving stream, about 10 seconds") m.streamFetcher = CreateObject("roSGNode", "DataFetcher") m.streamFetcher.url = m.top.backendBase + "/api/youtube/stream-info/" + slot.video.youtube_id m.streamFetcher.observeField("response", "onStreamResolved") m.streamFetcher.control = "RUN" return end if
showLoading(true, "No playable source", "Skipping to next video...") skipToNext() end sub
sub onStreamResolved() body = m.streamFetcher.response if Len(body) = 0 showLoading(true, "Stream unavailable", "Skipping to next video...") skipToNext() return end if info = ParseJson(body) if info = invalid or info.success <> true or info.url = invalid showLoading(true, "Stream unavailable", "Skipping to next video...") skipToNext() return end if showLoading(true, m.currentSlot.video.title, "Starting playback...") startPlayback(info.url, m.currentSlot.seek) end sub
sub startPlayback(url as String, seek as Integer) content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.title = m.currentSlot.video.title content.url = url content.streamFormat = detectFormat(url) m.video.content = content m.video.seekMode = "accurate" m.video.seek = seek m.video.control = "play" end sub
function detectFormat(url as String) as String u = LCase(url) if Instr(1, u, ".m3u8") > 0 then return "hls" if Instr(1, u, ".mpd") > 0 then return "dash" return "mp4" end function
sub onVideoState() s = m.video.state if s = "playing" showLoading(false, "", "") else if s = "finished" playCurrentSlot() else if s = "error" showLoading(true, "Playback error", "Skipping to next video...") skipToNext() end if end sub
sub skipToNext() timer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") timer.duration = 2 timer.observeField("fire", "playCurrentSlot") m.top.appendChild(timer) timer.control = "start" end sub
sub showAndScheduleHide() m.overlay.visible = true m.hideTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onHideOverlay() m.overlay.visible = false end sub
sub showLoading(visible as Boolean, mainText as String, subText as String) m.loadingBg.visible = visible m.loadingText.visible = visible m.loadingSub.visible = visible if visible m.loadingText.text = mainText m.loadingSub.text = subText end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" or key = "options" showLoading(false, "", "") m.video.control = "stop" m.top.closed = true return true end if if key = "up" or key = "down" showAndScheduleHide() return true end if if key = "OK" or key = "play" showAndScheduleHide() return true end if return false end function
